rule.primary: service-level error rate: (misses + false alarms) / (N x tasks), per arm and N
rule.secondary: exact-set success per run; cost and latency are descriptive only
rule.failed_units: a unit (the single call, a group or a plan) without a parseable answer claims nothing: its violators count as misses, and failed units are reported
rule.oneshot_degrades: at N > 32: oneshot errors >= 10 and error rate >= 0.5%
rule.fanout_worth_it: at N: oneshot errors >= 10 and the fan-out arm's errors are at most half of oneshot's
rule.framework_vs_program: at N: framework_better if split-32 errors >= 10 and team-16 errors are at most half of split-32's; program_better if team-16 errors >= 10 and split-32 errors are at most half of team-16's; otherwise no_clear_difference
rule.infrastructure: a unit attempt that saw HTTP 429/5xx or a request without a response is rerun from fresh state, at most 3 attempts per unit; only the last attempt is graded; every attempt is kept
rule.scope: exploratory: one model, temperature 0, 4 tasks per N, one sample each
